title: Free, open-source Manus alternative, on your own device · {name}
description: {name} does the work on your files with any AI, one on your computer included. Free and open source, no credits, and your files stay on your device.
h1: An open-source alternative to Manus that keeps your work on your device
lede: Manus does your work on a computer in its cloud. {name} does it in your browser tab, with your files on your device and the AI you choose, the one on your own computer included. Free, open source, and no credits to count.
cta2: Get the AI on this computer
facts: Any AI, a local one included
fair.title: Manus, fairly
fair.body: Manus takes a task and carries it through by itself, on a virtual computer in its cloud with internet access, then hands back finished work: research, slides, websites, pictures, video. It keeps going when you close the tab, can start on a schedule or when something happens in your apps, and reads skills written as SKILL.md, as {name} does. Its desktop app reaches the folders you authorize, asking before each command unless you choose Always Allow. It is made by Butterfly Effect, a company incorporated in Singapore.
table.rows: In your browser tab, on any recent computer, phone included. Nothing to install.
On a virtual computer in Manus’s cloud, reached from the web, its phone apps or its desktop app.
On your device, in this browser, encrypted. No {name} server keeps them in a form it can read.
On Manus’s servers: what you upload, what it makes, the commands it runs and their logs. Folders on your computer connect through its desktop app.
Any: on this computer, a free one, your key, your plan.
Its own. With Manus Flex, in beta, your key from one of eight providers; but no address of your own or self-hosted AI, and pictures and video still cost its credits.
The AI you choose. With the AI on this computer, nobody.

Manus and the outside AI services it uses, which may not train on your content unless it says so. Its terms let it use your content to develop and improve its services, and data may go to the United States.
{name} is free; the AI may not be.

A free plan with limited credits, then $20 a month for 4,000 credits, $40 for 8,000 or $200 for 40,000, plus 300 credits a day; 17% less if paid yearly. What a task takes depends on how complex it is, and plan credits reset each month.
No {name} account. A child gets a profile a parent sets. The AI you choose may ask for an account; the one on this computer doesn’t.
It can act in accounts you log into, keep credentials where a feature allows, and buy what you approve.
Yes, MIT. Anyone can read every line.
A folder IT serves from its own address, behind its gateway and sign-in.
A Team plan from $20 a seat a month, with single sign-on ($150 flat under 30 seats), audit logs, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001. The owner can read members’ tasks.
Plain files and backups. ChatGPT’s, Claude’s and Gemini’s exports come in.

In August 2026, going independent again, Manus gave certain users 12 days to back up what they’d made since December 2025 before deleting it. Its backups are encrypted archives that restore into Manus.
better.title: Where Manus does better
better.items: It works with your laptop closed, on a schedule or when something happens in your apps: a new email, a refund, a pull request. {name} works while it is open.
One account and it’s ready: Manus picks the AI, and pictures, video, music and 3D come built in. {name} asks you to choose an AI first.
It puts many helpers on a big job at once, with Wide Research.
It publishes what it builds: websites and apps on its own hosting or your domain.
It holds SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certificates, which some companies ask for. {name} holds neither, and offers IT a trust pack instead.
both.title: Use both
both.cards: Payslips and medical letters with the AI on this computer; the big cloud jobs with Manus.
Both read SKILL.md. Those that need no program outside the browser work in {name} as they are.
Services you reach by their address connect to {name} too, signed in from the browser; the others go through a gateway.
catch.items: {name} works while it is open. Close the tab and it waits for you; nothing goes on in a cloud.
{name} is free; the AI behind it may not be.
Without a sign-up, only the AI on this computer answers. It needs 12 GB of memory and a recent graphics chip, and no phone runs it.
Your work lives in this browser. Clear its data without a backup and it’s gone.
Manus’s backups don’t come into {name}. Bring the files themselves.
faq.items: Is there a free, open-source Manus alternative?
{name} is free and MIT. It does the work on your files with any AI, and the AI on this computer costs nothing.
Yes: the AI {name} downloads to this computer, or yours in Ollama or LM Studio. Your files stay on your device with any AI; one in the cloud reads only what a request sends it.
No. {name} has nothing to count. The AI you choose may charge you, through your key or your plan, or not at all.
Does it do the work, or only chat?

It does the work: it makes documents, spreadsheets, slides and web pages, runs code inside the tab, walled off from your computer, and reads the sites you allow. Before sending, deleting or reaching outside, it asks you first.
Can I move my work from Manus?
Bring the files it made: drop them in {name} and carry on. Its backups and tasks don’t come in; ChatGPT’s, Claude’s and Gemini’s exports do.
What happened to Manus users’ data in August 2026?

Manus said that, as it went back to being an independent company, it would delete data certain users had made since December 2025, and gave them 12 days to back it up and a way to restore it. Accounts it didn’t affect kept everything.
end.title: Give {name} a file and keep what it makes
